packet.title: Shared IR, optimizer seam, evaluator interfaces (design)

body.p: After . Owns src/ir_internal.h, src/ir_pass_internal.h, src/evaluator_internal.h, src/function_library_internal.h (). IR as in : atoms, explicit focus variables, steps with a context atom, map, filter, quantified and sort nodes, functions with capture lists, static function references, try/catch and node construction reserved for XQuery and XSLT. The pass interface (Phase 1: a verifier only). Evaluator entry points and struct sxml_dynamic_context. The native function table (name, arities, signature, body, focus dependence) with one row array declared per src/function_library_<part>.c of 1.20 to 1.22. Done when IR for let $f := function($x){$x + .} return $f(4) and /a/b[2] is written out in comments, and an XQuery FLWOR and an XSLT apply-templates lower into it with no new node kind (or a named extension point). Spec: XPath 4.0 §2.2, §3.4 (coercion rules). Done 2026-10-16 ().
